tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Answer user tickets; tickets awaiting a reply come first.
tickets.closeHint: The user can still read the history; replying later reopens the ticket automatically.
tickets.closedHint: This ticket is closed. Sending a reply reopens it.
tickets.pickHint: Choose a ticket on the left to read the conversation; use ↑/↓ to move through the list.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Publish announcements; control visibility and order. Content supports Markdown.
notices.emptyHint: Published notices appear on the user dashboard and notices page.
notices.urlInvalid: Enter an image URL starting with http(s)://
notices.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag.
notices.showHint: Hidden notices are not shown to users.

knowledge.title: Knowledge base
knowledge.description: Write guides and tutorials, organised by language and category; bodies can include subscription placeholders.
knowledge.sortFilteredHint: While filtered, moving an article swaps it with the next visible article only.
knowledge.emptyHint: Write guides for downloading clients, importing the subscription and more.
knowledge.loadFailed: Couldn't load the article. Try again later.
knowledge.accessSample: Content visible only to users with an active plan
knowledge.languageHint: For example zh-CN or en; other language codes work too.
knowledge.categoryHint: Pick an existing category or type a new one.
knowledge.placeholdersHelp: Placeholders are replaced when users read the article: {{siteName}} site name, {{subscribeUrl}} subscription URL, {{urlEncodeSubscribeUrl}} URL-encoded subscription URL, {{safeBase64SubscribeUrl}} URL-safe Base64 subscription URL. Content wrapped by “Subscribers only” is shown only to users with an active plan.
knowledge.showHint: Hidden articles are not shown to users.
